purpose: Offline reference-voice listening comparison; all task details are fictional and confer no action authority.

samples.text: 我在呀。你慢慢说，我听着。
samples.check: Natural friendly delivery without exaggerated cuteness

samples.text: 明天上午十点有项目讨论，下午两点要交报告。
samples.check: Ten in the morning and two in the afternoon remain distinct

samples.text: 邮件已经准备好了。你看一下内容，确认后再发送。
samples.check: A prepared draft is not pronounced as already sent

samples.text: 好，改成三点半。我再核对一下有没有时间冲突。
Hi, I'm Alice. I'm here. Take your time.
The meeting is at ten tomorrow morning, and the report is due at two in the afternoon.
samples.check: Natural English with the same recognizable speaker

samples.text: Your email is ready. Have a look before we send it.
Sure, three thirty. Let me check whether anything else overlaps.
samples.check: Time pronunciation and smooth sentence transition

samples.text: 我喺度呀，你慢慢講，我聽緊。
samples.check: Colloquial Cantonese, not Mandarin reading of the same characters

samples.text: 聽日朝早十點有個會，下晝兩點要交份報告。
samples.check: Natural Hong Kong Cantonese time expressions

samples.text: 封電郵準備好喇。你睇吓內容，確認咗先發。
samples.check: Natural final particles and correct draft status

samples.text: 好呀，改做三點半。我再睇吓嗰個時間有冇撞期。
samples.check: Tone consistency, date/time accuracy and fluid phrasing

samples.text: 聽日個 project meeting 改咗做三點半，記得帶埋 laptop。
samples.check: Natural code switching without changing speaker identity

samples.text: 我把邮件主题设成 FYP email test，你先看一下。
samples.check: English title remains intelligible inside Mandarin
